title: BRO Geomorphological Map 1:50,000 — Geomorphological areas (GMM)
description:
80,148 landform polygons of the national Geomorphological Map of the Netherlands 1:50,000 (Geomorfologische kaart, GMM), classified by genesis, relief and landform subgroup. Produced under VRO; bronhouder Wageningen Environmental Research.

🤖 AI/Agent users: see AGENTS.md for field descriptions, query examples and usage tips.

links.title: PDOK dataset page: BRO Geomorfologische kaart (GMM)
Column definitions: BRO Catalogus geomorfologische kaart (GMM) v1.1
BRO Geomorphological Map 1:50,000 — Geomorphological areas (GMM) documentation

table:columns.name: fid
table:columns.description: Feature ID.

table:columns.name: collection_id
table:columns.description: ID of the geomorphological area collection (Geomorfologische vlakcollectie) this polygon belongs to (GMM cat. 4.3.2.1 identificatie).

table:columns.name: identification
table:columns.description: Unique ID of the map polygon (Kaartvlak identificatie), a published spatial-object identifier for external reference (GMM cat. 4.3.3.1).

table:columns.name: relief_code
table:columns.description: Relief-form code.

table:columns.name: active_process
table:columns.description: Whether the landform process is still active (ja/nee).

table:columns.name: genese_code
table:columns.description: Genesis code (1=Glaciaal, 2=Periglaciaal, 3=Denudatief, 4=Fluviatiel, 5=Eolisch, 6=Lacustrien, 7=Marien, 8=Organogeen, 9=Antropogeen, 0=Tectonisch).

table:columns.name: landform_subgroup_code
table:columns.description: Landform subgroup code (e.g. B44 = stroomrug/stream ridge).

table:columns.name: additional_surface_relief_code
table:columns.description: Additional surface relief code (optional).

table:columns.name: additional_surface_cover_code
table:columns.description: Additional surface cover code (optional).

table:columns.name: genese_description
table:columns.description: Genesis description (Dutch).

table:columns.name: genese_validfrom
table:columns.description: Start date (yyyymmdd) from which the recorded genesis (ontstaanswijze) value is valid; material history per GMM cat. 2.5, 4.3.8.3.

table:columns.name: genese_validto
table:columns.description: End date (yyyymmdd) of validity of the recorded genesis value; empty while current (material history, GMM cat. 2.5).

table:columns.name: landform_subgroup_description
table:columns.description: Landform subgroup description (Dutch).

table:columns.name: landform_subgroup_url
table:columns.description: URL to the landform legend entry.

table:columns.name: landform_subgroup_validfrom
table:columns.description: Start date (yyyymmdd) from which the recorded landform subgroup (landvormsubgroep) value is valid (material history, GMM cat. 2.5, 4.3.7.5).

table:columns.name: landform_subgroup_validto
table:columns.description: End date (yyyymmdd) of validity of the recorded landform subgroup value; empty while current (material history, GMM cat. 2.5).

table:columns.name: additional_surface_relief_description
table:columns.description: Relief addition (toevoeging relief): further typing of the relief and/or relative elevation of the landform unit (GMM cat. 4.3.7.1, list 5.4).

table:columns.name: additional_surface_relief_validfrom
table:columns.description: Start date (yyyymmdd) from which the recorded relief addition is valid (material history, GMM cat. 2.5).

table:columns.name: additional_surface_relief_validto
table:columns.description: End date (yyyymmdd) of validity of the recorded relief addition; empty while current (material history, GMM cat. 2.5).

table:columns.name: additional_surface_cover_description
table:columns.description: Cover addition (toevoeging bedekking): typing of the deviating sediment layer covering the landform subgroup (GMM cat. 4.3.7.3, 6.3.6).

table:columns.name: additional_surface_cover_validfrom
table:columns.description: Start date (yyyymmdd) from which the recorded cover addition is valid (material history, GMM cat. 2.5).

table:columns.name: additional_surface_cover_validto
table:columns.description: End date (yyyymmdd) of validity of the recorded cover addition; empty while current (material history, GMM cat. 2.5).

table:columns.name: relief_klasse
table:columns.description: Relief class (reliefklasse): whether the relief code is for valley-shaped (dalvormige) or non-valley landform groups (GMM cat. 4.3.9.2, 4.3.10).

table:columns.name: relief_subklasse
table:columns.description: Relief description (relief) of the non-valley relief code, e.g. 'Vrij vlak, laaggelegen relief'; empty for valleys (GMM cat. list 5.3).

table:columns.name: helling
table:columns.description: Slope: class of the angle of the steepest slope of the landform; non-valley relief codes only (GMM cat. list 5.3, 6.3.3).

table:columns.name: lokaal_maximaal_hoogteverschil
table:columns.description: Local maximum height difference within the landform, in metres; non-valley relief codes only (GMM cat. list 5.3, 6.3.3).

table:columns.name: diepte_tov_omgeving
table:columns.description: Depth of the valley incision relative to the surroundings, in metres; valley relief codes only (GMM cat. list 5.2 diepte).

table:columns.name: steilste_verhang
table:columns.description: Steepest gradient (steilste verhang) of the valley form; valley relief codes only (GMM cat. list 5.2).

table:columns.name: maximaal_hoogteverschil
table:columns.description: Maximum height difference within the form, in metres; valley relief codes only (GMM cat. list 5.2).

table:columns.name: maximaal_verval
table:columns.description: Maximum drop (maximaal verval) of the valley, in metres; valley relief codes only (GMM cat. list 5.2).

table:columns.name: relief_validfrom
table:columns.description: Start date (yyyymmdd) from which the recorded relief typing is valid (material history, GMM cat. 2.5, 4.3.7.4).

table:columns.name: relief_validto
table:columns.description: End date (yyyymmdd) of validity of the recorded relief typing; empty while current (material history, GMM cat. 2.5).

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: Feature geometry (WKB) in EPSG:28992 (Amersfoort / RD New).

table:columns.name: geom_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float, ymin: float, xmax: float, ymax: float>
table:columns.description: Per-feature bounding box struct for spatial filtering.
